Card Q&A.a: You can digivolve into this card from a red or blue level 6 Digimon by paying its digivolve cost.
Card Q&A.q: How can I digivolve into this card?

Card Q&A.a: Yes. The chosen Digimon and all Digimon with the same name as that Digimon are deleted.
Card Q&A.q: I use this card's When Digivolving effect to choose one of my opponent's Digimon. Is that Digimon deleted?

Card Q&A.a: Just [Greymon]. Only Digimon with names that completely match the specified name are deleted.
Card Q&A.q: I choose [Greymon] with this card's When Digivolving effect while my opponent has a [Greymon], [MetalGreymon], and [WarGreymon] in play. Are all of them deleted, or just [Greymon]?

a: Yes. The card numbers may be different, but the names match. All of your opponent's [MetalGreymon] cards are deleted.
Card Q&A.q: My opponent has [ST1-09 MetalGreymon], [BT1-021 MetalGreymon], and [BT1-114 MetalGreymon] in play in their battle area. I use this card's When Digivolving effect to choose [ST1-09 MetalGreymon]. Are all of my opponent's [MetalGreymon] cards deleted?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can choose not to.
Card Q&A.q: If I attack with this Digimon when it has a level 6 Digimon card in its digivolution cards, do I always have to activate this card's When Attacking effect?
Can I use this card's [When Attacking] effect to return a level 6 digivolution card to my hand but choose to not unsuspend this card?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Choose 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Delete all of your opponent's Digimon that share a name with it.
[When Attacking] You can unsuspend this Digimon by returning 1 of this Digimon's level 6 digivolution cards to your hand.
